status: authored display vocabulary; runtime integration is owned separately
authority: User canon defines the fiction; lexical sources establish Japanese readings and senses only.

display_policy.case: uppercase canonical terms and model names
display_policy.first_introduction: Include a short functional English gloss.
display_policy.long_vowels: KESSHO and RAICHO intentionally omit macrons in game labels. Source readings remain documented.
display_policy.alias_scope: Historical display aliases are exact labels, not substring replacements or save identifiers.

terms.game_sense: The technological species descended from biological humanity in Galaxy Royale.
Crystal vocabulary used for KIKAI crystal horns and named crystal resources; existing material tiers remain authoritative.

terms.lexical_sense: rock ptarmigan; the Japanese name literally means thunder bird
terms.game_sense: The fictional flight craft piloted by KIKAI, named with thunder-bird inspiration.
terms.usage_guard: RAICHO is not the standard Japanese word for spacecraft and does not identify the game craft with a real-world mythological Thunderbird tradition.

identity_rules.main_manufacturer: Hair color, main RAICHO manufacturer and the existing single starter ability.
identity_rules.sub_manufacturer: Crystal horn color; no extra starter ability or combat bonus.
identity_rules.sponsor: Arena sponsorship is independent of main/sub manufacturers, appearance, license and ability grants.
identity_rules.rename_scope: Three corporation starter display models only. Champion and later hull names require a separate authored review.
